run_pascal_part_clip_embeddings: run the pascal_part_base_clip_name module to generate CLIP text embeddings for PASCAL-PART base categories
build_clip_text_features: build CLIP text feature vectors for PASCAL-PART part-level category names using RN50 model
generate_prompt_templates: generate prompt templates for PASCAL-PART categories with options like 'a', 'none', 'photo', or 'scene'
save_clip_embeddings_npy: save CLIP text embeddings as a numpy .npy file for downstream vision-language tasks
review_pascal_part_categories: review the PASCAL_PART_BASE_CATEGORIES list of 78 part-level object categories with ids and names
